label: Breaking News: V.T.C. Is Producing Raptures!

lines.text: New reports suggest the Lift may not have been initiated by Missilis after all, but by V.T.C.
At the same time, a disturbing theory is gaining traction.
Their so-called "miracle" can regenerate severed limbs and restore dead nerves, and it may already have been used to create something far more dangerous: a steel monstrosity!
If that miracle is real, then it's not out of the question.
So what exactly were they trying to build?
Are they planning to conquer the world using those ruthless machines that have been slaughtering humans?
And is the United Forces of Humanity truly unaware of all this?
It's time they gave us answers.
